verdict.rationale: Render's docs say you can connect a repo and ship with every push, and a community user calls it easier to set up than Heroku. That covers the repo-connect and auto-deploy part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows Render detecting or inferring build settings, so the 'without manual build configuration' part is unproven. Missing for 10: documented automatic build/runtime detection, evidence that no build or start commands need to be entered, hands-on corroboration of zero-config deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration
